basics.name: Jixian Liu
basics.label: Ph.D. Student in Electrical and Computer Engineering
basics.summary: Jixian Liu studies safe and reliable autonomous systems at the intersection of control theory, robotics, and machine learning. His research develops data-driven, learning-based, and generative methods for safety verification, particularly for complex systems where exact computation is intractable and guarantees must be obtained from limited data drawn from complex distributions. Using system symmetries, structural inductive biases, and compact latent representations, he aims to enable real-time, data-efficient safety verification that can be deployed in real-world robotic systems. He is advised by Enrique Mallada. Before coming to Johns Hopkins, he completed a B.S. degree in Physics at Xi’an Jiaotong University.
